player_prompt.intro: Waxaad tahay ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ee ciyaarta dhagax-warqad-goosad {num_rounds} wareeg ah. Hadafkaagu waa inaad ku guuleysato wareegyada ugu badan ee suurtogalka ah. Wareeg kasta, ka jawaab mid ka mid ah: '[rock]', '[paper]', ama '[scissors]'. Waxaad sidoo kale u isticmaali kartaa '[r]', '[p]', ama '[s]' sida gaabis

outcome.p0_wins: Ciyaaryahanka lambarkiisa eber waa kan badisay wareegyada!
outcome.p1_wins: Ciyaaryahanka 1aad ayaa badisay wareegyada ugu badan!
